name: Maryland FFA
what_you_do: Join an FFA chapter through your school's agricultural education program. FFA builds leadership, personal growth and career skills through agriculture classes, projects and competitions.
who_can_apply: Students in a high school agricultural education program. The site says Maryland FFA has almost 3,000 student members in 50 chapters. Age and grade rules are not listed on the pages read.
pay_detail: Membership dues are not stated on the pages read. Ask your chapter advisor.
deadline_text: The state site lists a deadline to confirm or add chapter affiliation membership on Oct 15, 2026 at 5 p.m. The exact time for students to join is set by each chapter.
how_to_apply: Ask your school whether it has an agricultural education program and FFA chapter. The Maryland FFA home page has a Join FFA button and a chapters page.
notes: The 2026 National FFA Convention and Expo is listed on the site for Oct 20 to 24, 2026 in Indianapolis. If your school has no FFA chapter, contact the Maryland FFA office through the Contact page.
